title: Grateful Dead Live at Alpine Valley Music Theatre on 1989-07-19
source: Master Audience Recorded By Mr. Baker, Transfer By Keo; Nakamichi CM300/CP4 Shotguns > Sony TC-D5M, Tapes: Maxell XLII-S 90's; Transfer With Nakamichi MR-1 > Korg MR-1000 @ 1 Bit/5.6 MHz; Tracking/Sample Rate Conversion/Flacked With AudioGate Software To 24/96 kHz; Metadata Tagging With Tag&Rename

ai_review.summary: Muddy audience recording of a killer show where the Dead were in perfect form.
ai_review.review: The audience tape has a noticeably muddy sound, but fans rave about the setlist and the band's tight performance. Reviewers call it one of the best shows they've seen despite the less‑than‑ideal audio quality.

ai_rating.rationale: High praise for the musical performance (5/5) offset by a muddy audience recording, yielding an overall strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audio described as 'muddy'; typical audience ambience with limited clarity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Setlist described as killer; band members noted to be in perfect form throughout.
